exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "It's okay to / May / Can (permission)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
～てもいい

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～てもいい matches "It's okay to / May / Can (permission)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～てもいい.
exercises.explanation: Expresses permission to do something; "may" or "can" in English.
